title: My grandmother
instructions: Ali büyükannesini anlatıyor. Yaşına, yaşadığı yere ve sevdiği şeylere dikkat et.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: This is my grandmother. Her name is Fatma.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: She lives in a small house in a village.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: She has a big garden with a lot of flowers.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: She loves cooking. Her cakes are very good.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: I visit her every Sunday with my parents.

questions.feedback: Yemek yapmayı (cooking) seviyor; pastaları çok güzel.
Her pazar (every Sunday) ailesiyle ziyaret ediyor.
questions.evidence: I visit her every Sunday with my parents.
